description: This file defines a utility class `Placeholders` for detecting and working with placeholder patterns in strings. It supports both a new format `{{ prefix:key }}` and a legacy format `${prefix.key}`, providing methods to check if a string contains placeholders and to obtain the relevant regex patterns.

classes.name: Placeholders
classes.description: Utility class for detecting placeholders in strings with support for both current and legacy formats. It provides precompiled regex patterns, group names, and static methods to identify placeholders within input strings.

methods.name: pattern
methods.description: Returns the combined regex pattern for identifying any placeholder, either in the current or legacy format.

methods.name: groupNames
methods.description: Provides the list of group names used within the regex patterns for extracting placeholder parts.

methods.name: containsAnyPlaceholder
methods.description: Checks whether an input string contains any placeholder (current or legacy format).
